LESSON: PAINTING AND MONTAGE

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Creating and Executing
Topic 1.3: Painting and Montage

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Painting and Montage
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How is glue for pasting pictures improvised?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. classify colours into primary and secondary for painting
2. create a montage composition for expression
3. appreciate painting and montage as methods of making pictures

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

• Model 2: create a montage composition for expression
• Model 3: appreciate painting and montage as methods of making pictures

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: classify colours into primary and secondary for painting
2. Practise: create a montage composition for expression
3. Practise: appreciate painting and montage as methods of making pictures

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Painting and Montage.
